title: Performance / max metrics (get_max_metrics)
description:
Returned by garminconnect's get_max_metrics(date) as a list, despite the garminconnect type hint claiming dict. Consumed by sync_performance. IMPORTANT: returns an empty list [] on days with no VO2max update — this is normal, not an error (confirmed via get_max_metrics_restday_2026-07-25.json fixture, not merged into this draft since it contributes no fields, only the empty-array possibility).

Verified against: 2026-07-28 (non-empty), 2026-07-25 (empty list — normal, no update that day). Additional fields beyond what's listed here may exist and are tolerated (additionalProperties: true) — Garmin adding new fields is not a breaking change; a listed field disappearing or changing type is.
